original_description: Design websites for businesses, brands, portfolios, blogs, and online stores. Create design briefs, sitemaps, wireframes, homepages, landing pages, responsive layouts, design systems, color palettes, typography, navigation, hero sections, forms, dark mode, and full HTML/CSS mockups. Get help with redesigns, UX, accessibility, website copy, branding, conversion-focused layouts, SEO-friendly design, Figma handoff, design-to-code workflows, and design reviews. Responses may include a clearly disclosed Web Design affiliate link.
